_comment: Optional. `hotpath init` discovers and writes these for you (running server, binary, model, log, launch arguments, path_prepend); `hotpath init --template` writes placeholders. Machine-specific values live in hotpath.local.json, which is gitignored. Every key is optional; commands tell you which one they need. server_args: the arguments your day-to-day llama-server runs with; `propose` uses them as the baseline arm when they match the observed command line and `diagnose` reads the microbatch from them (labelled 'declared, not observed') when a measured server did not report it. workload: default workload file for `propose`. log_requests_kept: newest per-request rows an observation keeps from the server log. discovery_roots: extra directories discover/inspect search (bounded). discovery_process_names: executable names treated as llama-server.
